# CellScaffold agent rules

## Build and disk hygiene

- Never run `swift build`, `swift test`, `swift run`, or create an ad-hoc
  `--scratch-path` directly on the host. Use
  `scripts/run_swift_bounded.sh <build|test|run|package> ...` or
  `scripts/run_tests_isolated.sh ...`.
- Never create timestamped CellScaffold build roots under `/private/tmp`.
  CellScaffold host builds must reuse the lease-protected managed cache selected
  by `scripts/run_swift_bounded.sh`.
- Every host build must pass `scripts/check_build_capacity.sh` first. Do not
  bypass its projected 40 GiB / 10 percent free-space floor.
- The bounded runner defaults to two Swift jobs. Raise
  `HAVEN_SWIFTPM_JOBS` only after recording a capacity/resource reason; do not
  remove the limit to make a stalled build appear faster.
- The bounded runner reports cache and filesystem deltas after every run and
  performs marker-, lease-, age-, and size-guarded cache collection. Do not use
  manual `rm`, `swift package clean`, or whole-`.build` deletion as a substitute.
- If a build is interrupted, inventory the managed cache before the next build.
  Preserve source, Git state, dependency checkouts, active deploy artifacts,
  signing material, and device/identity evidence.
- A local package override is development evidence only. SwiftPM can remove
  the matching remote pins from `Package.resolved`; inspect that file after
  local candidate builds and never commit local-path resolution drift.
- Xcode command-line checks must use `scripts/xcode-check.sh`, which uses one
  stable DerivedData path and the same capacity gate.
